hypothesis: Selecting the strongest of BTC, ETH and SOL only when its own trailing return is positive can retain cross-sectional momentum while avoiding forced long exposure in broad crypto bear regimes.
derivation_disclosure: Preregistered after v15 failed temporal consistency. It adds the standard absolute-momentum cash filter only; no threshold or parameter was fitted to v15 outcomes.

data_contract.input: independently checksummed Binance spot M1 aggregated to strict UTC D1
data_contract.decision_time: Monday 00:00 UTC using only prior completed D1 bars
data_contract.cash_filter: do not trade when the strongest asset trailing return is less than or equal to zero
data_contract.proxy_limitation: Positive evidence cannot promote until BTC, ETH and SOL native Ostium parity gates pass

execution_contract.ranking: trailing close-to-close return ending on Sunday close
execution_contract.exit: gap-adverse ATR stop or close after registered holding period
execution_contract.overlap: skip new Monday while prior position remains open

sqcli_policy: No SQCLI until development, validation, OOS, small-account and three parity gates pass.
